messages.content: "Can you help me find a Thai restaurant in New York, NY within a 10-mile radius, and then find an Italian restaurant in the same location within the same distance? After that, could you provide the precipitation statistics for the Amazon rainforest for the past year and then for the past five years?"

Then retrieve precipitation stats for Amazon rainforest for the past year and then for the past five years. Use function `ecology_data_precipitation_stats` twice with location="Amazon rainforest", time_frame="year" and "five_years".
